title: Verify degree-seven permutation-polynomial witnesses over GF(11)

source.citation: A classification of permutation polynomials of degree 7 over finite fields, arXiv:1812.02080

translation.notes: The 25 normalized GF(11) coefficient tuples printed by the source are retained as witnesses. Each polynomial is verified directly on every field element; this case does not claim to rerun the classification's completeness search.
